metadata.title: Nested Loop Grid
metadata.description: Print an n-by-m grid of stars using nested for loops.

instructions.main: Set `n = 3` and `m = 4`, then print a 3x4 grid of `*` — four stars per row, one row per line.
steps: Use an outer loop for the rows and an inner loop for the columns.
Print each star with `end=""` so the row stays on one line.
Print an empty line at the end of each row.

hints.message: Start with an outer loop over `range(n)` and an inner loop over `range(m)`.
You need one loop inside another — an outer loop for rows and an inner loop for columns.

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: Your nested loops print the full grid.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: The 3x4 grid prints exactly as required.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Print three rows of four stars, each row on its own line.
Use two `for` loops — one inside the other.
